specific_instructions.cart: CRITICAL: The shopping cart UI MUST be heavily themed in GREEN (#16A34A). Use this green for the checkout button, total highlights, and cart icons. Include radio/select options for 'Retiro en local / Envío a domicilio' and 'Efectivo / Transferencia'.
specific_instructions.sauce_selection: When adding a product categorized as 'Tacos' to the cart, a modal MUST appear requiring the user to select exactly 2 out of 7 sauces. The UI should use checkboxes. The 'Agregar' button must be disabled until exactly 2 are selected.
specific_instructions.admin_dashboard: Clean, high-contrast table layout for CRUD operations (Categories, Products, Sauces). Sidebar navigation.
specific_instructions.hardcoded_auth: Implement admin login checking for username 'matiasfrancese' and password 'matias123'.
specific_instructions.whatsapp_integration: The franchise inquiry button in the footer and the cart checkout button must construct a WhatsApp API link (https://wa.me/1155644915) with pre-filled messages summarizing the order.
specific_instructions.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn', data-testid='checkout-whatsapp-btn').
specific_instructions.qr_share: Include a QR code generator in the UI (perhaps in a 'Share' modal or footer) that links to the current site URL.

icons.usage: Use prominent icons for Cart, WhatsApp (Phone/Message), Info, Edit, Trash, Plus, Minus, Check.
